result.topic_en:
Riemann shows that two expansions of a fractional derivative differ only by polynomial-type terms that must vanish, introduces 'systems' of values of the general derivative obtained by adding terms $k rac{x^{-
u-n}}{\Pi(-
u-n)}$, and starts determining a value of $\partial^
u_x z$ via Taylor expansion of $z_{x+h}$ about $k$.

Definition of a system of values of the fractional derivative
Taylor series of z about k
Expansion of z in all powers of h giving a value of the fractional derivative from Taylor series at k
